name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) and Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) hard capture the key-then-door order, and the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) matches "after that". The soft Existence(target_picked_up) matches "try to". Blocker movement is guaranteed by the environment, not required by the task, so no clause is needed for it.

texts: Open the door: the door must be open at some point, reached after taking the key.
Take the key before opening the door: the door may not open before the agent has the matching key.
After opening the door, pick up the target box: the box pickup may not happen before the door is open.
Try to pick up the target box in the other room after the door is open.
